integratedprofiles-desc: Implements modern user profiles with the ability for other extensions to build on it.
integratedprofiles-prefs-edit-help: Change your banner, avatar, tagline, and links with [[Special:MyPage|Edit profile]] on your user page.
integratedprofiles-avatar-help: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP. Maximum $1 MB.
integratedprofiles-avatar-help-static: JPEG, PNG, or static WebP. Maximum $1 MB.
integratedprofiles-banner-help: Choose a gradient or upload your own cover image.
integratedprofiles-banner-help-size: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP. Maximum $1 MB. Wide landscape images work best.
integratedprofiles-field-featured-articl: The title of a page to highlight on your profile (must exist).
integratedprofiles-field-visibility-help: Your About page, contributions, and talk page always stay public.
integratedprofiles-visibility-public-hel: Anyone can see your profile details.
integratedprofiles-visibility-users-help: Only people who are signed in can see them.
integratedprofiles-visibility-private-he: Only you and moderators can see them.
integratedprofiles-field-hide-connection: Hide connected accounts on my profile
Hides any account connections from being visible on your public profile.
integratedprofiles-connection-external-h: You can edit your managed account connections on your Preferences page.
integratedprofiles-error-permission: You do not have permission to edit this profile.
integratedprofiles-error-invalid-json: Profile fields must be a JSON object.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-size: Avatar file is missing or too large.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-type: Avatar must be a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-animated: You do not have permission to upload animated avatars.
integratedprofiles-error-banner-size: Banner file is missing or too large.
integratedprofiles-error-banner-type: Banner must be a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image.
integratedprofiles-error-upload-too-larg: This image is too large to upload. Choose a smaller file.
apihelp-query+integratedprofile-summary: Get an IntegratedProfiles payload for a user.
apihelp-query+integratedprofileavatar-su: Get IntegratedProfiles avatar URL(s) for one or more users.
apihelp-query+integratedprofileavatar-pa: Username(s) whose avatars to fetch (pipe-separated; maximum 50).
apihelp-query+integratedprofileavatar-ex: Fetch avatar URLs for Alice and Bob
apihelp-setintegratedprofile-summary: Update IntegratedProfiles fields for a user.
apihelp-setintegratedprofile-param-usern: Username to update. Defaults to the current user.
apihelp-setintegratedprofile-example-1: Update the current user's about text
apihelp-integratedprofileuploadavatar-pa: Username whose avatar to replace. Defaults to the current user.
apihelp-integratedprofileuploadavatar-ex: Upload an avatar for the current user
apihelp-integratedprofiledeleteavatar-pa: Username whose avatar to delete. Defaults to the current user.
apihelp-integratedprofileuploadbanner-pa: Username whose banner to replace. Defaults to the current user.
apihelp-integratedprofileuploadbanner-ex: Upload a banner for the current user
apihelp-integratedprofiledeletebanner-pa: Username whose banner to delete. Defaults to the current user.
